project.name: Kirkton (Balmerino)
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Kirkton is retained as a route-linked historic locality. The nearby abbey is not reassigned to the settlement. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. Balmerino Abbey is a separate hamlet attraction and is not transferred into Kirkton. The small Balmerino roadside parking and abbey picnic tables are outside Kirkton. No current café, public toilet or dedicated visitor parking was verified.

features.name: Holly Cottage, Kirkton Of Balmerino
features.fullDescription: Late 18th/early 19th century. Comprises 2 cottages, W. part former school, single storey 2-window and centre door rubble with painted margins, later crenellation over door; slated piend roof, angle chimneys. E. part weavers house, single-storey pantiled 4 windows 2 doors. Picturesque.
